title: Everything Announced At Capcom Spotlight TGS 2026 - NewsBreak
text:
By Franz Christian Irorita ,
2 hours ago
Capcom kicked off Tokyo Game Show 2026 a day early with its Capcom Spotlight broadcast .
The roughly hour-long show focused mostly on updates to already-announced titles, headlined by Resident Evil ‘s jump to Nintendo Switch 2, a new Dragon’s Dogma II expansion, and fresh Street Fighter 6 and Monster Hunter Wilds news.
Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 Head to Nintendo Switch 2 Capcom confirmed the remakes of Resident Evil 2 , Resident Evil 3 , and Resident Evil 4 (as the Gold Edition) are all coming to Nintendo Switch 2, releasing simultaneously October 16. A Resident Evil 2 Deluxe Edition bundles in all previously released downloadable content, while the Resident Evil 4 Gold Edition includes the Separate Ways DLC alongside its other add-ons.
Digital pre-orders are open now, with an early-adopter discount available for a limited time. All three demos will be playable at the Capcom booth once TGS itself opens September 17 .
Switch 2 owners are also getting Resident Evil Requiem alongside the Ethan Winters Saga that bundles Resident Evil 7 Biohazard and Resident Evil Village .
Capcom used the segment to spotlight the franchise’s 30th anniversary as well, confirming tickets are now available for a dedicated 30th anniversary exhibit, a horror maze based on Requiem at Universal Studios Japan, and a 30th anniversary concert tour featuring music spanning the series’ history.
Dragon’s Dogma II: Dark Arisen Adds a Snowy New Region Dragon’s Dogma II: Dark Arisen sends players into Norgan, a long-abandoned, snow-covered region in the north once part of Vermund. There, players team up with a new companion named Eir to investigate the secrets of an undying Fallen Dragon, appraising recovered relics along the way to unlock new skills and equipment.
Twelve new challenge dungeons, called Lost Rites, are scattered throughout the main area, and the character creator is getting expanded customization options, with the Character Creation & Storage tool now available on Nintendo Switch 2 alongside existing platforms.
New Official Pawns created by outside partners are joining the game’s recruitable pawn pool, with more planned in future updates.
Dragon’s Dogma II: Dark Arisen releases October 9 on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, with pre-orders open now across all platforms, following a recent title update that fixed longstanding performance issues ahead of the expansion’s launch.
Street Fighter 6 ‘s Arjun Arrives October 13 Arjun, the second new character for Street Fighter 6 ‘s Year 4, launches October 13, fighting with a yoga-based style built around unique projectiles, traps, and recoverable damage on blocked attacks, first detailed in our earlier breakdown of his original gameplay trailer .
Players can try him for the first time at the Capcom TGS booth ahead of release, and the Arjun Fighting Pass is already available. The same date brings a fourth outfit for a returning character as part of the game’s ongoing swimsuit-themed costume series.
Capcom also confirmed a tie-in with the upcoming Street Fighter film, releasing worldwide October 16, adding special Challenger Select screen art featuring the movie’s cast. Looking further ahead, Tifa from the Final Fantasy VII Remake series joins the roster in early 2027, with Bosch following that spring.
On the competitive side, Street Fighter League 2026 continues across Japan, the Americas, and EMEA, with regional playoffs running through November, and Capcom Pro Tour 2026 qualifiers remain open worldwide ahead of Capcom Cup 13.
Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance Reveals Teostra, Plus Switch 2 Details Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance continues the story after the Elder Dragon Lao-Shan Lung overwhelms the hunters of the Forbidden Lands, forcing the construction of a new stronghold, Madoi.
As the mists over Wyveria clear, players uncover the Skybound Eyrie, first revealed alongside the Elder Dragon Gundoraja , a region of floating ruins home to new threats, including the coordinated flying wyvern Araketa.
The broadcast confirmed a returning Elder Dragon for the expansion as well: Teostra, playable in a demo at the Capcom and PlayStation booths on PS5 Pro hardware alongside an Araketa hunt in the Skybound Eyrie, both available in solo or multiplayer.
Separately, Monster Hunter Wilds on Nintendo Switch 2, confirmed for a December 4 release with the full Ascendance expansion bundled in , will support local wireless multiplayer and crossplay with other platforms, launching with every prior update, hunt, and permanent event quest already included.
Physical pre-orders are available now, with a pre-order bonus of layered armor; the broadcast stated digital pre-orders begin October 20.
Capcom closed the show by highlighting a Tokyo Game Show digital sale, discounting Pragmata for the first time, alongside Resident Evil Requiem , the base Monster Hunter Wilds , Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection , and the Monster Hunter Rise plus Sunbreak bundle.
